macros.name: FSClear
macros.doc: This macro empties the FIFO/stack named fifoStackName, but the FIFO/stack can still be used to \FSPush or \FSUnshift new elements.

macros.name: FSCreate
macros.doc: This macro simply initializes all the required data for the FIFO/stack named by the value of the first argument, fifoStackName.

macros.name: FSDestroy
macros.doc: This macro destroys the FIFO/stack named fifoStackName.
